messages:
rachel: Postmortem follow-up )—we need a one-page checklist for rollout safety. Keep it actionable: who owns what, timers, and recurrence detection.

jamal: Agreed. Can we reduce blast radius by defaulting experimental flags to micro-samples (0.5%) and enforcing an emergency cap (1%) that only an approver can lift?

pavel: Yes. Also want precise signatures for auto-actions. My proposal: signature = (error_rate > 3x in 5m) OR (p99 latency > 2x in 5m) OR (quality_drop >= 2% on probe-set). 2/3 triggers quarantine, 3/3 triggers immediate rollback.

jessica: Love the 2-of-3 rule. We should store the exact gating_config_id on the deployment event so every postmortem can point at the policy used.

rachel: Draft gating snippet (YAML) for the RFC so infra can parse it:

```
gating_config_id: gc-202603-007
flag: ai-summaries
phases: [0.5%, 3%, 15%, 100%]
phase_timeout_mins: 50
micro_sample_pct: 0.5
emergency_cap_pct: 1
containment_window_mins: 12
signatures:
  - id: err_spike
    error_mult: 3.0
    window_mins: 5
  - id: latency_tail
    p99_mult: 2.0
    window_mins: 5
  - id: fidelity_probe
    eval_set: probe_small_v1
    drop_pct: 2.0
auto_sequence: [quarantine, fallback_pin, rollback]
fingerprint_fields: [flag, model_variant, signature_id]
```

jamal: Runtime behavior notes: quarantine pins 90% traffic to previous stable variant, routes 10% to canary with doubled probe sampling. fallback_pin holds for containment_window_mins then either heal or rollback.

pavel: Telemetry requirements: counters `guard.quarantine`, `guard.fallback`, `guard.rollback`, event `guard.fingerprint` containing sha256(flag|variant|signature_id), and gauge `guard.time_in_quarantine`. We need these to detect repeats.

jessica: Analytics: run a weekly job that groups guard.fingerprint and auto-open a recurring-review task when a fingerprint appears >1x in 60 days. Owners should rotate and close with a root-cause or a mitigation.

rachel: Action items (owners + timelines):
 - rachel: write the RFC + canonical YAML examples (due 3 business days)
 - jamal: runtime enforcement (emergency cap + quarantine behavior) (due 2 weeks)
 - pavel: probe-set + eval hook + snapshot baselines (due 7 days)
 - jessica: recurrence dashboard + weekly job + task automation (due 3 weeks)

safewatch-bot: REMINDER: all PRs changing rollout defaults must include `./ci/rollout_smoke.sh` and attach `gating_config_id` to deployment audit events. Merge blocked without smoke success.

jamal: Also add counters for operator actions: `guard.hold_approved`, `guard.manual_rollback` so we can measure HCI.

pavel: Small UX ask: gating configs should have `hold_until_approval: boolean` so teams can opt-in to manual promotion.

rachel: I'll file the RFC and tickets now and tag owners. If nobody objects I will set the dates.

jessica: No objections. :+1:

pavel: ACK. Will start probe integration tomorrow.

jamal: ACK. Starting runtime branch.

rachel: Thanks all. I'll post links when RFC+PRs are up.
